accepted_scope: An explicit binary coordinate equivalence Q from BinaryVector (3*s) to K cubed yields a five-word tape-to-semantic tuple equivalence. The pulled-back good tape set has cardinality equal to the dependent good-five-tuple sigma, and the complete tape space has cardinality 2^(13*s).
remaining: Q, A, U and tuple-dependent basis b are supplied. This does not prove the actual constructor-selected basis, event soundness or the numerical success probability.
